title: MTBC lineages 1–4 as a geographic barcode
dek: L1 Indo-Oceanic, L2 East-Asian/Beijing, L3 East-African–Indian, L4 Euro-American are the four common human M. tuberculosis sensu stricto lineages. They are covariates and phylogenetic-SNP traps, not drugs.
story: Coll’s SNP barcode (and later expansions) assigns MTBC to numbered lineages. The four lineages that dominate global human tuberculosis caused by M. tuberculosis sensu stricto are L1 (Indo-Oceanic), L2 (East-Asian, including Beijing families), L3 (East-African–Indian), and L4 (Euro-American). L5 and L6 are M. africanum; L7 is associated with Ethiopia; L8/L9 are rare African lineages added as sampling improved. Animal-adapted ecotypes sit off this four-colour map.

Lineage is a successful human-adapted clade, not a MIC. L2/Beijing is over-represented in many MDR datasets; that is transmission of resistant clones plus possibly mutation supply — tested on its own plate. L4 is globally scattered with named sublineages (Haarlem, LAM/L4.3, T, X). L1 and L3 have their own phylogenetic markers that naive catalogues once graded as resistance.

A clinical report should put lineage next to SNP distance and next to known phylogenetic not-associated variants. It should not put lineage in the BDQ column. Sublineage names from old spoligotyping (Beijing, LAM, Haarlem) are coarser than a barcode; map them before comparing papers.
deep: Phylogenetic SNPs: some pncA, gidB, and embB alleles are lineage-defining or lineage-associated and not resistance. Version the WHO catalogue; subtract not-associated markers.
Clock and transmission: within-lineage SNP distances are the clustering object. Between-lineage distances are hundreds of SNPs and are not “household transmission.”
Reference bias: mapping everything to H37Rv (L4) is usually fine for DST SNPs and less fine for some PE/PPE and structural work in L1/L2. Say the reference.
M. bovis and BCG are not L1–L4. A urine “MTBC” after bladder BCG is a speciation problem (RD1), not a new Indo-Oceanic outbreak.

visual.caption: Four common human Mtb lineages as named stars, plus africanum and rare African leaves that a barcode must still assign. Weight is schematic global burden, not a MIC.

example.title: An L1 phylogenetic SNP in a DST column
example.setup: TBProfiler flags an embB change as ethambutol-R. The isolate is L1. EmbB M306 is wild type. The flagged SNP is a known L1 phylogenetic marker graded not-associated in the catalogue version you should have been using.

steps.title: Lineage first
steps.body: Assign the barcode. L1 is a prior for some not-associated embB/pncA-neighbourhood SNPs. The Beijing plate is the L2 analogue of this reflex.

steps.title: Grade, don’t regex
steps.body: “embB mutation” is not a result. “embB M306V, associated, AF 0.99” would be. A phylogenetic SNP should not flip EMB.

steps.title: Distance is still within L1
steps.body: Household clustering is still a small SNP distance among L1 isolates, not “they are all L1 so they are one outbreak.”

example.takeaway: L1–L4 are covariates and trapdoors for phylogenetic SNPs. They are not DST.

check.prompt: The four common human M. tuberculosis sensu stricto lineages are:
choices: L1 Indo-Oceanic, L2 East-Asian/Beijing, L3 East-African–Indian, L4 Euro-American
Group A, B, C, and BCG
check.answer: L1 Indo-Oceanic, L2 East-Asian/Beijing, L3 East-African–Indian, L4 Euro-American
check.why: That is the barcode most pulmonary-TB genomes fall into. Africanum is L5/L6.

whyWrong.MAC, kansasii, abscessus, leprae: NTM / M. leprae, not MTBC lineages.
whyWrong.Group A, B, C, and BCG: WHO drug groups plus a vaccine.

check.prompt: Two isolates, different major lineages (L2 vs L4), 400 SNPs apart. This is most consistent with:
choices: Deep phylogenetic separation, not a recent transmission pair
check.answer: Deep phylogenetic separation, not a recent transmission pair
check.why: Between-lineage distances are large. Recent transmission is a within-lineage handful of SNPs (after masking), not hundreds.

whyWrong.Household transmission last month: Clock rates do not produce 400 SNPs in a month.
whyWrong.Identical BCG lots: BCG is not an L2-versus-L4 pulmonary pair.

check.prompt: On the constellation, “not a drug” is weighted because:
check.figureHint: A high-weight term among lineage names.
choices: Lineage assignment should not be written as a susceptibility call
check.answer: Lineage assignment should not be written as a susceptibility call
check.why: The plate’s hygiene line. L2’s MDR over-representation is epidemiology, not a MIC.

whyWrong.L1 means PZA-R always: PZA intrinsic-R is an M. bovis story, not L1.
